worldcombat.skill.growth.summary: Raise Attack and Special Attack, with stronger gains in sunlight. Temporarily grow larger where there is room; cramped spaces limit size without preventing the stat boosts.
worldcombat.skill.growth.use.0: Open a fight by growing once to pad both offences
worldcombat.skill.growth.description.0: Currently grants +%1$s Attack and +%2$s Special Attack stages. Sunlight strengthens the growth.
worldcombat.skill.growth.description.2: Returning to normal size or clearing Grown retains the stat stages until their ordinary expiry. Wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.growth.timing: The telegraph can be interrupted without paying anything; PP and cooldown settle only after commit.
worldcombat.skill.growth.preference.ai.m: Consider growing when a threat is within this distance; larger commits earlier.
worldcombat.skill.growth.preference.ai.w: On: in sunlight the companion grows ahead of the shared order (each offence gains an extra stage). Off: distance only, no waiting for sun.
worldcombat.skill.growth.preference.ai.s: On: skip growth outside sunlight and save it for a sunny moment. Off: grow in shade too (one stage less each).
worldcombat.skill.growth.body: Body and collision size grow by up to %1$s for %2$s, then return. Special Attack affects growth, and level affects duration. Recasting refreshes this window without stacking ever larger bodies.
